name: Common-size cash inflow
expression: Cash inflow line ÷ Total cash inflows
meaning: A source-defined cash-flow analysis measure used for comparison and interpretation.
intuition: Relates operating cash generation or free cash flow to its claimants, investment needs, or comparison base.
workedExample: See the free-cash-flow worked examples in the lesson.
commonMistake: Failing to normalize IFRS classification choices or reversing numerator and denominator.
relatedLearningOutcome: analyze and interpret both reported and common-size cash flow statements
